content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Senior Project Manager - Research at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur)
Developing a novel rare-earth modified AlSi10Mg alloy via laser additive manufacturing for high-temperature automobile and aerospace applications
Various internal users of the Institute (IIT KHARAGPUR)
5 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Maximum age limit 35 years as of 30.06.2026 (Age limit 40 years; age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Ph.D with minimum 5 years experience OR MTech/ME/MDes/MBA/CA/ICWA or equivalent degree with minimum 10 years working experience or B.Tech/BE/MA/MCA or equivalent degree. HRA as applicable. Desired Experience & Criteria: The candidate should either possess a PhD degree or have completed their PhD synopsis seminar from a reputable institute/university/research lab in the field of Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science. Strong fundamental knowledge in the domains of mechanical behavior of materials and physical metallurgy. Previous experience in experimental work in the laboratory related to metallurgical sample preparation, operating test equipment, such as furnaces and testing equipment, is required. The candidate must have more than 2 research papers published in SCI-indexed international journals.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is upto Rs. 78,800 per month, depending on qualification and experience, along with HRA as applicable. The tenure of the assignment is 5 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

Mention the transaction details such as UTR Number or Transaction ID in the Application Form.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as of 30.06.2026, with an overall age limit of 40 years, subject to relaxation upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any.

faq.answer: Application fee can be deposited through RTGS, NEFT, or Net Banking into the specified IIT SRIC-OM bank account at State Bank of India, and transaction details must be recorded in the application form.
